class.name: PCGWeightedVariantSelector
class.brief_description: Deterministic, bounded, weighted procedural variant selection based on stable point IDs.
class.description: An Unreal PCG Mesh Selector Weighted-inspired data-only selector. For each input point ID, returns an integer variant index sampled from shared relative weights. This class selects indices, not actual mesh resources, so it can be applied to meshes, material variants, foliage colors, or other procedural attributes. It does not mutate the scene, rendering server or global random generator.

method.name: choose_variants
method.description: Returns one 0-based variant index per stable point ID, using a reproducible unsigned 32-bit avalanche hash and cumulative weighted intervals. One to 32 relative weights are supported, with each finite in [0, 1000000] and at least one strictly positive. Zero-weight entries are never selected. Stable IDs and seed must be integers in [0, 2147483647]. Up to 16,384 point IDs are accepted. Invalid input is rejected before producing any output and returns an empty array. A valid empty point array also returns empty. Duplicate IDs are permitted and yield the same choice with identical weights and seed. Reordering the input IDs does not change the variant assigned to any ID.
